description: Mosaedi connects ChatGPT to the authorized IB Law practice system to view cases, sessions, legal deadlines, clients, invoices, and documents, and to create or update records within the user’s permissions. Each practice is isolated. The assistant asks for confirmation before write operations, new invoices remain drafts unless explicitly sent, and generated content must be reviewed by a lawyer and is not legal advice.
